stock.provenance: Study assumption: two units per CPRI source value per stage

calibration_shot: Rank-1 setting at 50 % of its recommended charge; one shot.
validation_shots: Ranks 1-5 at full charge, rank 1 at 75 % charge, best setting with two fewer stages.

gate.G1_crest: Per impulse type, median |crest error| over all mismatch scenarios and validation shots with fitted parameters <= 50 % of the uncalibrated median.
gate.G2_timing: Per impulse type, median |front| and |tail| errors with fitted parameters <= the uncalibrated medians.
gate.G3_recommendations: Recommendations re-made with fitted parameters pass on the true generator at least as often as uncalibrated ones in every scenario and impulse type, and more often in total.
gate.G4_no_regression: No scenario/impulse/metric where the fitted-parameter p95 |error| exceeds the uncalibrated p95 by more than 2 percentage points.
gate.G5_control: With no true difference, fitted-parameter errors stay below 0.5 % for every metric.
gate.decision: All five must hold for the fitted-parameter workflow to be offered in the application; otherwise it stays an experiment.
